items.raw_excerpt: The mysterious Yorkshire village dividing opinion over its ‘eerie’ atmosphere
items.summary_en: A visitor said a quiet village in Yorkshire felt eerie and a little off. Locals are divided over the village's strange and unsettling atmosphere.

items.raw_excerpt: The Portuguese national team is training today at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen, their final session before Thursday’s Nations League clash against Denmark, with captain Cristiano Ronaldo’s participation in doubt.
items.summary_en: The Portuguese national team trained at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen on Tuesday. Captain Cristiano Ronaldo may not take part in the session before Thursday's Nations League match against Denmark.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 대표팀이 화요일 코펜하겐 파르켄 스타디움에서 훈련했다. 주장 크리스티아누 호날두는 목요일 덴마크와의 네이션스리그 경기를 앞두고 이번 훈련에 참가하지 못할 가능성이 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Después de la caída de la selección chilena frente a Estados Unidos por 4-2 en el Energizer Park, el equipo adiestrado por Nicolás Córdova retomó la jornada de entrenamientos con vistas a sue duelo con México, el cual se disputará este próximo 6 de octubre en California.
items.summary_en: The Chilean soccer team went back to practice after losing 4-2 to the United States. Coach Nicolas Cordova's players are getting ready to play Mexico on October 6 in California.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 축구 대표팀은 미국에 4대 2로 진 뒤 훈련을 다시 시작했다. 니콜라스 코르도바 감독의 선수들은 10월 6일 캘리포니아에서 열리는 멕시코전을 준비하고 있다.
items.title_en: Chile's Team Back to Training After Loss to US

items.raw_excerpt: Oportunidade faz parte do Programa Futuras Cientistas, vinculado ao Ministério de Ciência,Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), que deu início nesta semana às inscrições ao projeto Imersão Científica 2027.
items.summary_en: A program called Futuras Cientistas has opened sign-ups for Imersão Científica 2027. The project is linked to Brazil's Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation. It will bring students and teachers to visit technology centers.

items.raw_excerpt: An environmental group in American Samoa is taking legal action against the United States government over its [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/pacific/749226/pacific-voices-condemn-us-plan-for-offshore-mineral-extraction-off-american-samoa plans for deep-sea mining near the territory.
items.summary_en: An environmental group in American Samoa has filed a lawsuit against the United States government. The group wants to stop plans for deep-sea mining near the territory. The plans would take minerals from the ocean floor.
items.summary_ko: 아메리칸 사모아의 한 환경단체가 미국 정부를 상대로 소송을 제기했다. 이 단체는 미국의 심해 채굴 계획을 막으려 한다. 해당 계획은 섬 근처 해저에서 광물을 캐는 내용이다.
items.title_en: American Samoa environmental group sues US government over deep sea mining plans
